title: WAN 2.5 Video Generation Prompt Schema
description: Schema for validating WAN 2.5 video generation prompts produced by this skill.

prompt.description: Main scene/action description following the 4-Dimensional formula: Scene + Subject Action + Camera Movement + Audio/Dialogue. Keep under 200 words for reliable generation.

negative_prompt.description: Elements to exclude from generation. Keep under 50 words. Common terms: blurry, distorted, flickering, low quality, watermark, text overlay, static noise.
negative_prompt.default: blurry, distorted, flickering, low quality, watermark, static noise, jittery motion

resolution.description: Output resolution. 480P recommended for best quality (then upscale). 720P for balanced. 1080P available but may introduce artifacts.

aspect_ratio.description: Frame aspect ratio. 16:9 for widescreen/cinematic. 9:16 for vertical/mobile. 1:1 for square/social.

duration.description: Clip duration in seconds. 5s recommended for best quality. 10s for continuous motion sequences only.

seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. Use the same seed across shots in a scene for visual continuity. Null for random.

enhance_prompt.description: AI-powered prompt expansion. Set to true for short/simple prompts. Set to false when using detailed 4-Dimensional prompts for precise control.

audio.description: Enable native audio generation (voice, SFX, background music). Only available in WAN 2.5.

guidance_scale.description: Prompt adherence strength. CRITICAL: Keep between 5.0-7.0. Values above 10 cause flickering. Values below 3 cause drift. 6.0 is the recommended default.

sample_steps.description: Number of denoising steps. 20-30 recommended for quality. Lower for faster iteration. Higher for more detail.

quality_mode.description: Quality preset. 'fast' for quick previews. 'balanced' for general use. 'off' for best quality (slowest, recommended for hero shots).

generation_mode.description: Generation mode. text-to-video creates from prompt only. image-to-video animates a source image (prompt should focus on motion/camera only).

source_image_url.description: URL or path to source image for image-to-video mode. Required when generation_mode is 'image-to-video'. Null for text-to-video.

audio_description.description: Structured audio cues for audio-enabled generation. Only used when audio=true.

voice.description: Dialogue or voiceover description. Keep to short phrases (1-2 sentences).

sfx.description: Sound effects matching on-screen actions. Be specific about timing and source.

music.description: Background music description. Use genre + mood format (e.g., 'soft lo-fi jazz', 'tense orchestral strings').

camera.description: Structured camera movement data. This supplements the prompt text — the prompt should also contain camera instructions in natural language.

speed.description: Movement speed. Maps to prompt modifiers: slow='slowly/gently', medium='steadily', fast='quickly/aggressively'.

intensity.description: Movement intensity/amplitude. Subtle for barely perceptible motion, dramatic for sweeping moves.

metadata.description: Pipeline tracking metadata. Not sent to WAN 2.5 API — used for internal tracking.

skill_version.description: SKILL version that generated this prompt.

continuity_anchor.description: Whether this shot serves as a visual reference for continuity.

examples.prompt: A rain-soaked alleyway in 1940s Shanghai at night, neon signs reflecting off wet cobblestones. A woman in a red qipao slowly turns to look over her shoulder. Slow dolly in from wide shot to medium close-up. Distant jazz music, rain pattering on awnings, muffled footsteps.
examples.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted, flickering, low quality, watermark, modern clothing, daylight

audio_description.sfx: Rain pattering on fabric awnings, muffled footsteps on wet stone
audio_description.music: Distant smoky jazz saxophone, muted and atmospheric
